diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~42% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.
